ai_usage_cost_consistent.name: ai_usage_cost_consistent
ai_usage_cost_consistent.value: ("ai_usage"."cost_source" = 'unknown' and "ai_usage"."cost_usd" is null) or ("ai_usage"."cost_source" <> 'unknown' and "ai_usage"."cost_usd" is not null and "ai_usage"."cost_usd" >= 0)

audio_generations_selected_complete.name: audio_generations_selected_complete
audio_generations_selected_complete.value: not "audio_generations"."selected" or ("audio_generations"."status" = 'completed' and "audio_generations"."file_id" is not null)
